description: Auto-classification of existing Msingi content against the official KICD structure (audit of 2026-10-05). Identity is by Msingi record ID and by official natural key (grade code + subject code + official number). 'label' is for humans only and is never used for matching. Nothing is moved; learner data is untouched. All rows are unreviewed until an admin confirms them.

statusMeaning.exact: Same official node (name and placement agree).
statusMeaning.probable: Very likely the official node; content should be checked.
statusMeaning.needs_review: A candidate exists but the fit is uncertain.
statusMeaning.no_match: No official node found in the current version for this grade.
